'''Jualdhe''' is a village on the banks of the [[Alindrelle Erinin]], to the southwest of the island of [[Tar Valon]]. It is nestled at the foot of a great [[Ogier]]-built bridge,{{ref|{{bwb}}}} which arches like stone lacework{{ref/book|4|1}} a mile across the river to the Shining Walls. From the foot of the bridge and through the village stretches a major road, which leads directly to [[Maradon]] far to the northwest.

[[Zerah Dacan]] rides south along the [[River Erinin]] and passes through Jualdhe on her return from [[Salidar]], in an effort to disguise her origination by truthfully stating that she arrived from the north.{{ref/book|8|26}}

There was also a Jualdhe Bridge out of Tar Valon.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jualdhe}}
